<Meta title="Theme/Theming" />

<Title>Theming</Title>

A theme is an extension of the default theme bundled within the `@zextras/carbonio-design-system` package.

The theme customization can be accomplished by providing a modifier function to the `extension` prop:

<CustomThemeProvider />

<Source code={CustomThemeProviderSrc} />

When using typescript and [styled-components](https://styled-components.com/),
the type of the theme inside a styled component is automatically augmented by the design system itself,
which extends the DefaultTheme of styled component with the Theme of the DS.

If the theme includes some custom properties, the interfaces of the design system should be augmented to reflect these
custom props.
To do so, create a declaration file theme.d.ts in a proper place (root folder or @types folder or types folder) and
declare the module '@zextras/carbonio-design-system', extending the appropriate interfaces.

```typescript noedit static
import type { ThemeColorObj } from '@zextras/carbonio-design-system';

declare module '@zextras/carbonio-design-system' {
  interface Theme {
		additionalThemeProperty: unknown; // give the proper type
  }
  interface Palette {
    additionalColor: ThemeColorObj;
  }
}
```
